name: Nzanyi
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.note: Only atlas/classification refs (Blench 2019 Atlas, ALCAM 2012); no phonology or grammar located online

sources.citation: OLAC. 2025. OLAC resources in and about the Nzanyi language (Wayback snapshot, Nov 2025)
sources.note: Lists only Glottolog, Ethnologue and LINGUIST List entries for nja: no language descriptions, no archive deposits.

sources.citation: Eberhard, Simons & Fennig (eds.). 2024. Ethnologue, 27th ed.: Nzanyi (free view, Wayback 2024)
Newman, Paul. 2022. Comprehensive Bibliography of Chadic and Hausa Linguistics, 5th ed. Bloomington: IUScholarWorks
sources.note: Only two entries carry the Nzangi/Nzanyi keyword: Benton 1912a (Notes on Some Languages of the Western Sudan, Barth vocabularies) and Kraft 1981 (Chadic Wordlists). No phonology, grammar or thesis on Nzanyi is listed; Benson 2014 is absent.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2019. An Atlas of Nigerian Languages, ed. IV. Cambridge: Kay Williamson Educational Foundation. Entry 360 Nzanyi (p. 78 area)
sources.note: Names, location, dialects (Paka, Rogede, Nggwoli, Hoode, Maiha, Magara, Dede, Mutidi; Lovi in Cameroun); Refs: 'Grammar: Benson (2014)' only. Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Gravina, Richard. 2014. The Phonology of Proto-Central Chadic. LOT Dissertation Series 375. Utrecht: LOT (data-source table, PDF p. ~41; Section III intro)
sources.note: Table row 'Nzanyi [nja] Bata none' (no data source for Nzanyi); the reconstruction is explicitly 'not including tone or stress'.

sources.citation: Kraft, Charles H. 1981. Chadic Wordlists, vol. II (Marburger Studien zur Afrika- und Asienkunde A 24). Berlin: Reimer — 'Njanye' list as digitised in lexibank/kraftchadic (CLDF)
sources.note: 420 Njanye forms with tone diacritics (grave for low); wordlist only. Kraft's per-language prose 'Notes' (consonants, vowels, tones) are not in the CLDF derivative and the print volume is not online; no stress statement seen.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid page nzan1240 (Hammarström et al.)
sources.note: Classification comment cites Benson 2014: xii; AES threatened; no other descriptive reference attached.
Cite only Ethnologue 18, Blench 2019 Atlas and ALCAM 2012; no phonological content.

sources.citation: Benson, Ishya. 2014. Nzanyi grammar write-up 2014. Jos: Theological College of Northern Nigeria. xii+69 pp. (unpublished manuscript)
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.access_detail: open link recorded by Glottolog or the catalog, not checked; access check: not located online or at Harvard
sources.note: The only description of Nzanyi in existence (Glottolog's sole descriptive reference; Blench Atlas 'Grammar: Benson (2014)'); a 69-page grammar write-up from a TCNN/NBTT translation programme almost certainly opens with a phonology section that would state the tone system and any stress remark. Glottolog (Harald Hammarström) holds a PDF copy.

sources.citation: Meek, C. K. 1931. Tribal Studies in Northern Nigeria, vol. I: 282-93, 'The Njai or Nzangi' (with Nzangi vocabulary). London: Kegan Paul, Trench, Trübner
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held

sources.note: Oldest primary record: ethnographic chapter plus vocabulary; Meek's language sections occasionally carry a phonetic note. archive.org item tribalstudiesinn0001ckme is controlled-lending only (not yet US public domain).

sources.citation: Benton, P. Askell. 1912. Notes on Some Languages of the Western Sudan. London: Oxford University Press (reprinted 1968 as The Languages and Peoples of Bornu, London: Frank Cass) — Nzangi keyword in Newman 2022
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.access_detail: open copy online, not fetched sources
sources.note: One of only two Nzangi-keyworded items in Newman's Chadic bibliography; includes Heinrich Barth's unpublished vocabularies. Vocabulary notes, unlikely to state stress, but it is the whole remaining record. Only the 1968 reprint is on archive.org (lending-only).
